Umar, told that his collector had appointed a freed slave versed in the Book of Allah, quoted the Prophet: by this Book Allah exalts some peoples and degrades others.
The Prophet forbade travelling to enemy land with the Quran, fearing it would fall into the enemy's hands.
Reciting the verse on allegorical verses, the Prophet said to avoid them, angrily said earlier peoples perished disputing over the Book, and bade people recite only while hearts agree.
